name: activecalculator
description: WordPress plugin for embedding ActiveCalculator calculators with a block, shortcode or Elementor widget
author: Abdul Moiz

scripts.dist: npm run build && node -e "require('fs').rmSync('.dist',{recursive:true,force:true})" && mkdir -p .dist/activecalculator && rsync -a --exclude-from=.distignore ./ .dist/activecalculator/
scripts.plugin-zip: npm run dist && node -e "require('fs').rmSync('activecalculator.zip',{force:true})" && cd .dist && zip -rq ../activecalculator.zip activecalculator
scripts.plugin-check: wp-env run cli wp plugin check activecalculator --require=./wp-content/plugins/plugin-check/cli.php
